title: LinkedIn Certification Checker | Yes or No
description: LinkedIn certification checker. Give a profile URL and the certificate name. The row says yes or no, including short names like PMP or AWS and longer names like Lean Six Sigma. One charge per profile checked, Starting from $0.45 per 1,000.

certification.title: Certification they must have
certification.description: The name to look for, such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect or PMP. A shorter alias can go in Also accept.

aliases.title: Also accept
aliases.description: Other names for the same certification. A profile matches if any name is found.

urlsCsv.title: Or paste CSV
urlsCsv.description: A url column. One URL per row is also accepted.

fileUrl.title: Or upload a CSV file
fileUrl.description: CSV with a url or linkedinUrl column.

maxUrls.title: Maximum URLs
maxUrls.description: Cost-control cap. Maximum 50,000. A list over 200 continues if the run stops.

concurrency.title: Concurrent requests
concurrency.description: How many profiles to check at the same time.

resumeId.title: Resume ID (optional)
resumeId.description: Reuse this ID to skip profiles that already succeeded.

freshStart.title: Check finished profiles again
freshStart.description: Turn this on to ignore saved progress and check the whole list again.
